# Jiayang Chen

> Full stack developer based in Houston, Texas. Builds web apps like Authometry, 55GMS, and Lofi Radio.

## About

Jiayang Chen (GitHub: jiayangc1) is a full stack developer based in Houston, Texas, United States, and has worked across frontends and backends, with a few IT infrastructure projects as well. This site is Jiayang's personal portfolio and primary contact point.

## Expertise

- Full stack web development
- Databases, cloud, and infrastructure
- OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
- React, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Python, Swift, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare

## Projects

- Authometry: OAuth you can see — an inspectable OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect platform. https://authometry.jiayangchen.com
- 55GMS: Browser games, apps, and web proxy platform with hundreds of playable titles. https://55gms.com
- Lofi Radio: Lofi music 24/7, synced across browsers. https://lofi.jiayangchen.com
- What Beats Paper?: Try to beat an LLM at guessing what beats the other. https://whatbeatspaper.jiayangchen.com
- Imposter: The Imposter party game on the web, with no ads. https://imposter.jiayangchen.com
- Free GPT: A quick, free way to deploy your own AI chat. https://ai.jiayangchen.com
